influences.name: John Congleton
influences.context: When I was doing records with John Congleton or Jack Antonoff – not to be so blue collar about it – but time is money. We're in the studio. We're here to work, and this is what we're doing. Someone like John is super-efficient and fast.

influences.name: Jack Antonoff
influences.context: When I was doing records with John Congleton or Jack Antonoff – not to be so blue collar about it – but time is money. We're in the studio. We're here to work, and this is what we're doing. Same with Jack; super-fast.

influences.name: Judy Garland
influences.context: I love the scene in "The Wizard of Oz" where Dorothy first sees the Technicolor... I felt like I wanted to create something that was Technicolor, was visual as much as musical, and it's - and also, lyrically, it's this person, you know, wishing they had a spine made of iron and sort of along the thematic lines of "The Wizard of Oz."

influences.name: Disney
influences.context: The passages with the woodwinds and the vibrato voices, I was inspired by the scene where Snow White is singing at the well, and I just have such a soft spot for those Disney films, and I feel like I felt when I was five when I first saw them.
